messages.subject: Re: [stan] Problem installing rstan (#1613)
parts:
On Friday, September 18, 2015 at 2:04:11 PM UTC-4, Jonah wrote:
Yup, already responded on GitHub.

Can someone with a Mac try (re)installing rstan from develop after installing StanHeaders, ggplot2, and gridExtra from CRAN? Then try manipulating the following things while doing one of the stan_demo() models
  • specifying cores = 1 vs. cores > 1
  • specifying open_progress = FALSE vs open_progress = TRUE
  • inside RStudio vs. in Terminal
The only error among the 8 situations should be with cores > 1, open_progress = TRUE, and rstudio.

Thanks,
Ben
